title: Store your bike for a long time
summary: Prepare a bike to sit for a month or more so it starts and rides normally when you come back.
tools: Smart motorcycle charger or battery tender

steps.text: Change the oil if it's near its interval. Old oil holds acids that sit on the engine's internals.
Fill the tank and add fuel stabilizer, then ride a few minutes to get it through the system.
steps.caution: A full tank limits rust and condensation. Store away from flames and pilot lights.

steps.text: Wash and dry the bike, then lube the chain on chain bikes.
Inflate the tires to the pressure on your spec sheet, and use the center stand to keep weight off them.
Connect a battery tender, or remove the battery and charge it every month.
Cover the bike with a breathable cover in a dry place. Avoid plastic tarps that trap moisture.
Before riding again, check tire pressure, brakes, lights and the oil level, and let the engine warm up gently.
